title: Intersection of Three Sorted Arrays
description: Find common elements among three sorted arrays using three pointers.
pseudocode:
1. i = j = k = 0
2. while i < arr1.length && j < arr2.length && k < arr3.length:
3. if arr1[i] == arr2[j] == arr3[k]: result.push(arr1[i]); i++; j++; k++
4. else if arr1[i] < arr2[j]: i++
5. else if arr2[j] < arr3[k]: j++
6. else: k++

steps.note: Initialize pointers for all three arrays.
arr1[1]=2, arr2[0]=2, arr3[0]=2. All equal, found intersection.
Loop terminates as pointer exceeds array bounds.
